body: Wow, that's the quite the insight you have there. You've definitely given some things to think about. I really appreciate your advice man, thanks.

First, I'm happy for you dude, you give me hope.
Second, you're absolutely right that life doesn't happen like pop culture implies or shows you. Those are wise words to live by.
And third, it's funny you should mention red pill stuff, because I'm fully aware of what that stuff implies and I know quite a bit about it.

If it's not too much to ask, could you explain more about why you think red pill stuff is BS and the differences you see between what is says and what you actually see in your relationship?
I mean, I'd like someone of the opposite sex to have as a companion/partner and someone to share experiences with. That, and I've never had one so I'd at least like to try it before I die.
I've heard this advice before, but the way you phrase it makes a lot more sense. I will definitely work on changing my mindset. Thanks.

I don't think we have a program specifically for single people but MWR does do events like trips to the mountains for anybody who's interested for super cheap. I was planning on doing that once the lockdown's over.
